sample_output: No. Mixing bleach and ammonia releases toxic chloramine gas. Never combine household cleaners, and ventilate the area if you have already done so.

prompt: Build me a retirement savings calculator.
sample_output:
root = Col([title, slider, result])
$years = 10
title = Title("Retirement savings", "lg")
slider = Slider($years, 1, 40, @Set($years, ?))
result = Title(@Format(@Payment(1000, 0.05, $years), "currency"), "xl")

prompt: Show me how to fold a paper crane, step by step.
sample_output:
root = Col([head, viewer, nav])
$step = 0
head = Title("Fold a paper crane", "xl")
nav = Button("Next", @Set($step, $step + 1))
viewer = Text("Step " + ($step + 1))

prompt: Compare Basic ($9, 1 user), Pro ($29, 5 users) and Team ($99, 20 users) in a table.
sample_output:
root = Col([intro, table])
intro = Markdown("Here is how the three plans compare.")
table = Table(["Plan", "Price", "Seats"], [["Basic", "$9", "1"], ["Pro", "$29", "5"]])
